title: Abrego Garcia Arrives in Spain After Voluntarily Leaving U.S.
summary: Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia, who was wrongfully deported from the United States last year, arrived in Madrid on Wednesday, ending a 20-month legal fight.
caption: A lawyer spoke about the detainment of Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia outside federal court in Greenbelt, Md., last year.

title: Justice Dept. Apologizes for Making False Statement to Judge in Omar Case
summary: The acknowledgment came hours after the House’s top lawyer said the department mischaracterized his view on constitutional protections for lawmakers.
caption: The search of Representative Ilhan Omar’s apartment in Washington took place weeks before her re-election.

title: Officials Brief Congressional Staff on Intelligence Surrounding Nvidia Affair
summary: After President Trump said Jensen Huang was not a security threat, U.S. intelligence agencies told aides to lawmakers there was no evidence the woman at the heart of the scandal took directions from the Chinese spy agency.

title: Trapped on the Tarmac: 3-Hour Flight Delays Spike Under Trump
summary: Long delays have risen to levels not seen in more than 15 years, with no enforcement in sight.

title: C.I.A. Waterboarded More Detainees Than It Admitted, F.B.I. Interview Suggests
summary: The apparent disclosure was included in files released in response to a New York Times lawsuit. The release also shed light on C.I.A. officials’ fears about possible prosecutions.
caption: A 2021 view of a former C.I.A. compound near Kabul, Afghanistan, that held a “black site” known as the Salt Pit. It was apparently there that a translator for the agency said he had seen a man being waterboarded.

title: Sept. 11 Defendants Get New Opening to Challenge Death Penalty
summary: At issue is a clause in a plea deal involving Khalid Shaikh Mohammed, the man accused of being the mastermind of the plot, and two other defendants.
caption: A war court building at Guantánamo Bay, Cuba. Lawyers for two defendants in the Sept. 11 conspiracy case had asked the Guantánamo court judge “to formally recognize the proceedings as noncapital.”

title: Lukoil to Sell Foreign Assets, but Not to Kushner and Witkoff Associates
summary: Valuable properties belonging to the Russian energy giant will be sold to an American-led consortium. But Middle Eastern business contacts of the two Trump envoys pulled out because of political winds.
caption: The Burgas oil refinery in Bulgaria is one of Lukoil’s most important international assets.

title: Van Hollen’s Challenge to Schumer Highlights Democratic Rift on Israel
summary: Senator Chris Van Hollen says his move to replace Senator Chuck Schumer as party leader isn’t about Israel, but his sharply critical stance toward the Jewish state has become a major fault line in the race.
caption: Senator Chris Van Hollen has played a prominent role in seeking to condition the sale of offensive weapons to Israel over the past several years, a position that increased his popularity with progressives.

title: Why Aren’t the Midterms Over in Louisiana? Ask the Supreme Court.
summary: A landmark Supreme Court ruling reshaped the state’s congressional map and set up runoffs for two open seats.
caption: In late April, the Supreme Court, weakening the Voting Rights Act, declared that Louisiana lawmakers had improperly considered race when drawing the state’s congressional map to include a second majority-Black district.
